description.en: Vietnam is a socialist republic located on the eastern side of the Indochina Peninsula in Southeast Asia, bordered by the South China Sea to the east, China to the north, and Laos and Cambodia to the west. Possessing a rich history, a rapidly expanding economy, and a unique cultural synthesis, Vietnam is one of the fastest-growing countries in Southeast Asia.
description.zh: Vietnam是位於東南亞中南半島東側的社會主義共和國，東臨南海，北接中國，西連寮國與柬埔寨。越南擁有悠久歷史、快速成長的經濟與獨特的文化融合，是東南亞發展速度最快的國家之一。

seoText.en: Explore quick facts about Vietnam — population, land area, capital city, and a short overview. Learn about Vietnam's S-shaped geography, Red River and Mekong Deltas, French-Chinese cultural fusion, and modern role as a global manufacturing hub.
seoText.zh: 快速了解越南的基本資料：人口、面積、首都與簡短概述。探索越南狹長特殊的 S 型國土、紅河與湄公河三角洲地形、中法融合文化特色以及近年快速成長的外資經貿發展。

list: Socialist republic located on the eastern coast of Indochina
One of Southeast Asia's fastest-growing emerging economies
Rich history deeply shaped by East Asian and French influences
Global powerhouse in manufacturing and export-oriented industries
en.text:
Vietnam's history is deeply connected to East Asian traditions, followed by its integration into French Indochina during the 19th century. After enduring decades of war and division in the 20th century, the country was reunified in 1975 and has since successfully transitioned into a dynamic, market-oriented economy.

Today, Vietnam is recording explosive growth across manufacturing, electronics, textiles, and agricultural exports, establishing itself as a crucial link in modern global supply chains.

list: 位於東南亞中南半島東岸
快速成長的新興經濟體
歷史深受中國與法國影響
製造業與出口導向強國
zh.text:
越南歷史長期受到中國文化影響，後於 19 世紀成為法屬印度支那（French Indochina）的一部分。20 世紀經歷戰爭與分裂後，於 1975 年統一，逐步轉型為市場導向經濟。

今日越南在製造業、電子產業、紡織與農產品出口方面快速成長，並逐漸成為全球供應鏈的重要一環。

list: Situated on the eastern rim of the Indochinese Peninsula
Elongated, S-shaped national land structure
Northern highlands and fertile Red River Delta
Southern plains anchored by the massive Mekong River Delta
en.text:
Covering approximately 330,000 square kilometers, Vietnam features a narrow, S-shaped geography with stark geographic and climatic contrasts between the north and south.

The northern region is defined by rugged mountains surrounding Hanoi and the Red River Delta, while the long central waist is characterized by coastal hills. The fertile southern plains are anchored by the vast Mekong River Delta, a premier global agricultural hub.

list: 位於中南半島東部
國土呈狹長形狀
北部為山地與紅河三角洲
南部為湄公河三角洲
zh.text:
越南國土面積約 33 萬平方公里，地形狹長，南北氣候與地貌差異明顯。

北部以河內（Hanoi）周邊山地與平原為主，中部多山地與海岸線，南部則為肥沃的湄公河三角洲，是重要農業區。

list: Primarily characterized by a tropical monsoon climate
Significant climate contrasts between north and south
Highly distinct dry and rainy seasons
Northern provinces experience relatively cool winters
en.text:
Vietnam's climate is highly regional. The northern provinces experience four distinct seasons, including cooler winters, whereas the south remains hot and humid year-round.

The rainy monsoon season generally spans from May to October, strongly shaping agricultural activity and daily life. Coastal areas are also occasionally affected by seasonal typhoons.

list: 熱帶季風氣候為主
南北氣候差異明顯
雨季與乾季分明
北部冬季較涼
zh.text:
越南北部具有四季變化特徵，而南部則全年炎熱潮濕。

雨季通常集中在 5 月至 10 月，對農業與生活影響顯著。沿海地區偶爾受到颱風影響。

list: Population of approximately 100 million
High overall population density
Rapidly growing rate of urbanization
Highly favorable proportion of young demographic
en.text:
Vietnam's population is heavily concentrated in major metropolitan centers such as Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, as well as the coastal plains. 

Boasting a young, dynamic demographic, Vietnam serves as a vital labor resource in Southeast Asia. The Kinh (Viet) people constitute the dominant ethnic group, complemented by 53 recognized ethnic minorities.

list: 人口約 1 億
人口密度較高
城市化快速成長
年輕人口比例高
zh.text:
越南人口主要集中於河內（Hanoi）與胡志明市（Ho Chi Minh City）等城市地區。

人口結構較年輕，是東南亞重要勞動力來源之一。主要民族為京族（Kinh），但亦包含多個少數民族。

list: Highly dynamic and rapidly expanding emerging market
Driven heavily by export-oriented manufacturing sectors
A major recipient of massive foreign direct investments
Leading international hub for electronics and textiles
en.text:
Vietnam's economy is growing at a remarkable pace, establishing itself as a premier destination for global manufacturing relocations. 

Key export pillars include consumer electronics, smartphones, textiles, footwear, and quality furniture. The industrial zones around Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi continue to attract massive foreign enterprises.

list: 快速成長的新興經濟體
製造業與出口導向強
外資投資大量進入
電子與紡織產業重要
zh.text:
越南經濟近年高速成長，已成為全球製造業轉移的重要目的地之一。

電子產品、紡織、鞋類與家具出口為主要產業。胡志明市（Ho Chi Minh City）與北部工業區吸引大量外資企業設廠。

list: Socialist republic governed under a unitary system
Led by a single-party political framework
Centralized authority concentrated in the central government
Hanoi serves as the political and administrative capital
en.text:
Vietnam is a socialist state led by the Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV) under a single-party framework. 

Hanoi represents the administrative center and political heart, while Ho Chi Minh City stands as the primary economic and financial hub.

list: 社會主義共和制國家
一黨制政治體系
中央政府權力集中
首都為河內
zh.text: 越南由越南共產黨領導，採一黨制政治體系。河內（Hanoi）為首都與政治中心，而胡志明市（Ho Chi Minh City）則為經濟核心。

list: Highly competitive and affordable cost of living
Remarkably fast-paced urban development
Ubiquitous and iconic motorcycle street culture
Steadily rising educational standards and literacy
en.text:
Vietnam's urban centers feature a sea of motorcycles, which serves as a highly iconic element of daily street life. 

Supported by rapid economic growth, the urban middle class is expanding swiftly, leading to significant improvements in education, purchasing power, and general quality of life.

list: 生活成本相對較低
城市發展速度快
摩托車文化普遍
教育水平持續提升
zh.text: 越南城市交通以摩托車為主，是典型城市景觀之一。隨著經濟發展，中產階級逐漸擴大，教育與生活品質也持續改善。

list: Beautiful fusion of East Asian and French colonial heritages
Profoundly shaped by traditional Confucian values
Vibrant and rich calendar of traditional festivals
Exquisite culinary traditions celebrated globally
en.text:
Vietnamese culture is a unique synthesis of Confucian, East Asian, and French colonial heritages, creating distinctive artistic and architectural landscapes. 

Its fresh, balanced cuisine, including Pho and fresh spring rolls, has won massive acclaim globally. Tet (Vietnamese Lunar New Year) is the most sacred holiday, emphasizing ancestral respect and family reunions.

list: 中華與法國文化融合
儒家文化影響深厚
傳統節慶豐富
飲食文化全球受歡迎
zh.text: 越南文化融合東亞與法國殖民時期影響，形成獨特文化結構。越南河粉（Pho）與越南春捲等料理在全球廣受歡迎。越南新年（Tet）是最重要傳統節日，家庭團聚與祭祖文化十分重要。

list: Environmental pollution and metropolitan infrastructure pressure
Infrastructure development striving to catch up with growth
Pressing need for workforce and industrial skills upgrade
Noticeably widening socio-economic and income disparities
en.text:
Amidst rapid industrialization and urban migration, Vietnam faces environmental issues such as urban air pollution and intense traffic congestion.

Furthermore, upgrading the workforce to higher-value technological industries and bridging the urban-rural wealth gaps represent key challenges for the country's future development.

list: 環境污染與城市壓力
基礎建設仍在發展
勞動力轉型挑戰
收入差距逐漸擴大
zh.text: 越南在快速工業化過程中面臨環境污染與交通壓力。同時，經濟成長帶來城鄉差距與產業升級需求，是未來發展的重要挑戰。

list: Hanoi — Ancient historic capital and political heart
Ho Chi Minh City — Vibrant economic and commercial core
Da Nang — Dynamic central port city and tourist gateway
Ha Long Bay — World-famous UNESCO Natural World Heritage site
en.text:
Hanoi preserves a rich architectural heritage of ancient temples and French colonial quarters, while Ho Chi Minh City stands as a towering, highly modern global metropolis. 

Ha Long Bay, with its thousands of towering limestone karsts rising majestically from the emerald waters, represents Vietnam's most iconic natural wonder.

list: 河內（Hanoi）—— 首都與政治中心
胡志明市（Ho Chi Minh City）—— 經濟與商業核心
峴港（Da Nang）—— 中部重要港口與旅遊城市
下龍灣（Ha Long Bay）—— 世界自然遺產
zh.text: 河內（Hanoi）保留大量歷史與文化遺產，而胡志明市（Ho Chi Minh City）則是越南最現代化與國際化的城市。下龍灣（Ha Long Bay）以石灰岩地形與海灣景觀聞名世界，是越南最具代表性的自然景觀之一。

list: Active and crucial member of ASEAN
Expanding trade networks and global partnerships
Vital node in the modern global manufacturing chain
Pragmatically balances key relations with the U.S. and China
en.text:
Vietnam plays an increasingly vital and proactive role within ASEAN, with its strategic economic weight steadily rising. 

It has successfully forged robust free trade agreements globally and maintains highly balanced, close diplomatic relations with both the United States and China.

list: 東南亞國家協會（ASEAN）核心成員
與多國貿易快速成長
全球供應鏈重要節點
與中國與美國關係密切
zh.text: 越南積極參與東協合作，並在全球製造業供應鏈中地位持續上升。近年與美國、日本、韓國與歐盟的經貿關係快速深化。

list: Highly close economic and investment ties
Taiwan serves as a premier source of foreign investment
Heavy industrial and labor cooperation
Steadily rising tourism, academic, and civic interactions
en.text:
Vietnam and Taiwan maintain exceptionally close trade and civic partnerships, with Taiwan being one of Vietnam's largest foreign investors.

Numerous Taiwanese enterprises have established sprawling production bases in Vietnam across electronics, textiles, and heavy machinery, fostering deeply integrated economic ties.

list: 經貿與投資關係緊密
台商大量投資設廠
勞工與產業合作頻繁
觀光與教育交流增加
zh.text: 越南與台灣關係非常密切，台灣為越南重要外資來源之一。大量台灣企業在越南設廠，雙方在電子、紡織與製造業合作深厚。

list: Southeast Asia's premier fast-growing economic powerhouse
Key recipient and core country for global manufacturing shifts
Iconic and lively motorcycle-driven street culture
One of the world's leading exporters of robust coffee beans
Vietnamese Pho stands as a globally celebrated culinary icon
東南亞快速成長經濟體
製造業轉移核心國家
摩托車文化代表性強
世界重要咖啡出口國之一
河粉（Pho）為全球知名美食

text.en: Pho — The globally celebrated aromatic noodle soup representing the soul of Vietnamese cuisine
text.zh: 越南河粉（Pho）——享譽世界的香草高湯河粉，代表著越南料理的精髓與靈魂

text.en: Ha Long Bay — The breathtaking emerald bay dotted with thousands of towering limestone karsts
text.zh: 下龍灣——令人屏息的翡翠綠海灣，散落著數千座奇特壯麗的石灰岩群島

text.en: Vietnamese Coffee — Famous robust drip coffee, often served iced with sweet condensed milk or as egg coffee
text.zh: 越南咖啡——聞名全球的濃郁滴濾咖啡，常搭配煉乳冰飲，或調製成特殊的蛋咖啡

text.en: Motorcycle Stream — The massive, flowing river of scooters defining the dynamic urban landscape
text.zh: 摩托車車流——街頭如長河般流動的機車瀑布，定義了越南最具活力與特色的都市景觀

text.en: Hoi An Ancient Town — The atmospheric historic merchant port lit up by hundreds of colorful silk lanterns
text.zh: 會安古鎮——氛圍古典迷人的歷史貿易港口，入夜時由數百盞繽紛的絲綢燈籠點亮
